settings.text: These mats are perfect for keeping areas clean, sanitized, and safe.

settings.title: Sanitizing Disinfectant Doormats
settings.text: Designed for effective containment and passive application of liquid disinfectants, these mats are a necessity for any room subject to contamination. As visitors walk on them, these mats apply liquid disinfectant to the bottom of their shoes while also holding the liquid in place for long term use.

settings.title: Clean Stride Sanitizing Mats
settings.text: The Clean Stride Sanitizing Mats provide a two-step procedure, it begins with the WaterHog mat, equipped with small bumps to scrape away dirt and moisture from shoes, trapping them below foot level. Following that, the Clean Stride adhesive insert acts like a sticky surface, efficiently capturing even the smallest dust particles. A mere two steps on this mat successfully eliminate over 90% of the dirt.

settings.title: Hand Washing Message Mats
settings.text: Use these message mats to direct people to sanitize their hands. Perfect for sanitizer dispensing stations, these mats will grab the attention of your employees or customers and encourage them to sanitize their hands. Choose from a variety of colours, designs, and messages.

settings.title: SURE STRIDE DIRECTIONAL MATS
settings.text: These directional mats are adhesive-backed and printed with an arrow to provide directional cues to customers, visitors, and employees. Adhesive backing keeps the mat flat and in place, even with heavy cart and buggy traffic. Mats can be left in place during daily floor cleaning; floor scrubbers, mops, and brooms will pass right over them without causing damage. Anti-microbially treated for protection from odors.

settings.title: STICK-AND-STAND MATS
settings.text: These adhesive-backed mats are designed to clearly mark floors and provide customers with a safe place to stand while waiting in lines. Universal "stop sign" shape with shoe prints marks where customers should stand; mats can be placed at safe intervals in virtually any configuration. Anti-microbially treated for protection from odors. Low-profile high-traction surface provides additional traction and slip resistance.
